description.value: Smitty's is a Canadian casual dining chain founded in Calgary in 1960, with over 80 locations across Canada, serving all-day breakfast, pancakes, and comfort food classics. The Fort St. John location is one of the newer additions to the chain, confirmed open via the corporate news feed. For cyclists passing through the Peace River region, it offers a full sit-down dining experience with a broad menu served all day.

address.value: 8808 96A Street Unit P2, Fort St. John, BC

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The OSM record identifies this as a Smitty's Family Restaurant (branded chain, cuisine=pancake) at 8808 96A Street Unit P2, Fort St. John. The website is the corporate smittys.ca site; it confirms the brand is a Canadian casual dining chain since 1960, and the Latest News subpage explicitly lists 'Now Open In Fort St. John!' confirming this location is real and open. The corporate website does not provide location-specific amenity details (bike parking, Wi-Fi, etc.), so those fields default to null; the 'Order Now' feature on the homepage provides positive evidence for takeout.
concerns: Website is corporate-only (smittys.ca); no location-specific page found for the Fort St. John branch, so amenity details for this specific location could not be verified.
Phone number and street address could not be cross-checked against the website as no location finder page was captured.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible chain restaurant confirmed via corporate news ('Now Open In Fort St. John!'). A reliable full-service dining stop for cyclists in the Peace River region.
